name: Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation
summary: The Maharashtra government company that built the Mumbai–Pune Expressway and is now building the Samruddhi Mahamarg.
about: MSRDC was set up in 1996 to build big roads that the state PWD could not fund from its normal budget, paying for them by borrowing against future toll income. Its first project was the Mumbai–Pune Expressway, India's first proper access-controlled expressway, which opened in stages around 2000–2002 and changed what Indians expected a highway to be. It has since built sea links, flyovers and bypasses around Mumbai, and its largest project is the Samruddhi Mahamarg from Nagpur to Mumbai.
facts: Built the Mumbai–Pune Expressway, India's first access-controlled expressway.
Building the Samruddhi Mahamarg, a roughly 700 km expressway from Nagpur to Mumbai.
Also built the Bandra–Worli Sea Link and many of Mumbai's flyovers.
